crossRefs.note: He who is often rebuked and stiffens his neck will be destroyed suddenly, with no remedy.
The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz saw.
Their infants also will be dashed in pieces before their eyes. Their houses will be ransacked, and their wives raped.
A grievous vision is declared to me. The treacherous man deals treacherously, and the destroyer destroys. Go up, Elam…
“I have raised up one from the north, and he has come, from the rising of the sun, one who calls on my name, and he…
Yahweh says to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have held, to subdue nations before him, and strip kings of…
I call a ravenous bird from the east, the man of my counsel from a far country. Yes, I have spoken. I will also bring…
Therefore disaster will come on you. You won’t know when it dawns. Mischief will fall on you. You won’t be able to put…
“Assemble yourselves, all of you, and hear! Who among them has declared these things? He whom Yahweh loves will do what…
I, even I, have spoken. Yes, I have called him. I have brought him and he shall make his way prosperous.
“Go up against the land of Merathaim, even against it, and against the inhabitants of Pekod. Kill and utterly destroy…
“Make the arrows sharp! Hold the shields firmly! Yahweh has stirred up the spirit of the kings of the Medes, because…
“Set up a standard in the land! Blow the trumpet among the nations! Prepare the nations against her! Call together…
Prepare against her the nations, the kings of the Medes, its governors, and all its deputies, and all the land of their…
I will make her princes, her wise men, her governors, her deputies, and her mighty men drunk. They will sleep a…
“This is the writing that was inscribed: ‘MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPHARSIN.’
What do you plot against Yahweh? He will make a full end. Affliction won’t rise up the second time.
For entangled like thorns, and drunken as with their drink, they are consumed utterly like dry stubble.
For when they are saying, “Peace and safety,” then sudden destruction will come on them, like birth pains on a pregnant…
He who digs a pit may fall into it; and whoever breaks through a wall may be bitten by a snake.
“For, behold, I will send serpents, adders among you, which will not be charmed; and they will bite you,” says Yahweh.

translations.web: Won’t your debtors rise up suddenly, and wake up those who make you tremble, and you will be their victim?
translations.bsb: Will not your creditors suddenly arise and those who disturb you awaken? Then you will become their prey.
translations.kjv: Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite thee, and awake that shall vex thee, and thou shalt be for booties
translations.asv: Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite thee, and awake that shall vex thee, and thou shalt be for booty unto them?
